dedupe v2.1 -- remove duplicate lines

dedupe reads FILE (or stdin) and prints each distinct line once.

Flags:
  --ignore-case: compare lines case-insensitively
  --keep=first|last: which copy to keep (default first)
  --min-count N: only print lines seen at least N times
  --sep=STR   field separator
  -n, --dry-run
      do not write anything, just report how many would be removed

Pass -z to use NUL as the line terminator (same as --zero).
Example: dedupe --keep=last --min-count 2 words.txt
